dailyInsight.headline: Give delayed child approval a workflow return path
dailyInsight.insight: Microsoft Agent Framework now keeps unresolved child function approvals out of Agent.as_tool parent continuations, directing delayed approval to workflows.
dailyInsight.mechanism: Each delegated invocation has a child session. Immediate approval middleware rules can decide inside it; unresolved child function approvals fail the call. Propagated application state excludes framework approval and budget keys, including custom middleware identifiers.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: Showing a permission request does not establish that a later answer can resume the intended child operation. An approval that waits needs an owner for the suspended work and its return path.

actions.audience: Python Agent Framework developers using nested tools
actions.label: Audit who resumes each child approval
actions.instruction: In a disposable build containing PR #8527, identify each child tool requiring approval. Keep immediate policy inside the child; test a workflow call-and-return for a harmless request needing a later response. Verify the result returns to the intended coordinator and test checkpoint restoration separately if persistence is required.
actions.effort: 20–30 minutes with an existing test application

receipts.title: Isolate delegated approval state and fail closed on unresolved child approval
receipts.supports: The wrapper, tests and sample distinguish immediate policy from workflow-owned delayed approval and exclude framework continuation state from propagation.

receipts.title: The documented agent-tool approval boundary
receipts.supports: Merged intervention addressing a reported child approval that could not resume through the parent loop.

confidence.basis: The merged wrapper, regression cases and comparison sample agree on this bounded source-level contract.

dailyInsight.limitation: No released package mapping or independent model-backed reproduction was performed. The workflow sample simulates a wait; production persistence and the human interface require application work.
dailyInsight.falsifier: Revise this call if a build containing the change leaks unresolved child approval state into a fresh parent delegation, or later supported API behavior safely resumes delayed child approval through Agent.as_tool itself.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A released package and application test showing delayed workflow approval resumes the intended child and returns to its coordinator, including restoration when persistence is configured.
